subject: post
title: (R)POST.------IND.DY.TD.
description: Chart on book p. 312 (WI-28). POST (postulation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The title names IND-DY-TD; the chart has no label for it. From the subject: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From INFO-DY: INDIV-DY-TD (individual tendencies) and ATTN (attraction), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From INDIV-DY-TD: AFL (affinity alignment). From ATTN: AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree). From AFI-1: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics).
